asks.notes: Section B: the "Preparatory work" (scale and chord bank) is MARKED at Ordinary Level ("Grid / Stave", 1 mark per correct note of chord, 12), so its bullets are part of the question text and its line is a counted criterion (lane ruling). The chord bank prints I ("The first chord is given") and also iii and vii° already filled in and shaded, outside the five chords asked for: the 12 notes are those of ii, IV, V and vi; the pre-filled chords are part of the printed question, not separate asks. Each "1 mark per ... (1 X 12)" line is counted, each "Up to 3 marks for quality ... (3 X 4)" line a no-band criterion on 0-12 (12 + 24 + 24 = 60). The "1 X 12" / "3 X 4" sit in the scheme's Mark column, so the labels carry the descriptor only. The Section B general points (scheme p6, headed "Harmony") are carried on all three questions; 2018 prints no "ii – I generally not accepted" line (2019 does); "aug 4th", "dim 5th", "3rd" print their endings as superscripts. The 2018 Ordinary scheme prints NO table of given or accepted chords, so there is no scheme crop. "PREPARATORY WORK" is a printed heading, kept in the question text after the title (coordinator ruling 19 Nov: every printed line of the block). The title is printed in capitals and kept so (as 2018 Higher). PRINTED SIGN: the scale bullet prints "B" with a flat sign; the OCR carries it as "Bb", so the line is written "B♭" as read from the page (readFromPage) and second-read. Q4's (i)-(iv) name the cadences at A-D (the cadence words print in bold); one ask, one total. Key B flat major, 3/4.
